text:
elaine: Heads up — planning a release tonight at 22:00 PT: py-sdk 0.9.0 and ts-sdk 1.7.0. Also want to deprecate the legacy sync client (0.8.x). Window ~2h. Thoughts on pin strategy + canary cadence?
release-bot: Scheduled release window at 2026-03-20T22:00:00Z. Flow: staging -> canary -> promote. Manual trigger required. Job template available.
kevin: I'd prefer staged publish: publish npm with `canary` tag first for 1hr, then promote to `latest` if smoke is green. For Python, push an rc to TestPyPI then promote to PyPI (wheels + sdist).
anya: Agree. Need changelog + explicit deprecation note in docs. Also consider adding a runtime DeprecationWarning when the old sync client is imported so customers see it in logs.
elaine: Good call. Plan: add DeprecationWarning in 0.9.0 and schedule removal for 0.11.0. I'll draft a migration snippet in the docs.
sam: Quick note on rollback options: for npm prefer `dist-tag` flip (avoid unpublish). For PyPI we can't yank but we can push a follow-up patch and mark release in changelog. We should have a fast-path to re-tag npm to previous version: `npm dist-tag add redwood-js-sdk@1.6.3 latest`.
kevin: Exactly. Steps I'd run: publish to `canary` via `npm publish --tag canary`, run canary smoke tests, then `npm dist-tag add redwood-js-sdk@1.7.0 latest` to promote. For rollback: `npm dist-tag add redwood-js-sdk@1.6.3 latest`. Avoid `npm unpublish`.
elaine: We'll do canary -> smoke -> promote. Canary smoke: call integration endpoint used by our partner app and run latency + correctness checks for 30min.
devex-bot: Checklist: changelog.md updated? docs/migration created? release notes drafted? CI publish job configured? canary smoke job present? smoke test healthchecks in place?
anya: I'll own docs + release notes, ETA ~2h. Will include migration snippet and deprecation justification.
sam: I'll add CI steps: ensure `NPM_TOKEN` + `PYPI_TOKEN` secrets are used, publish wheel + sdist with `twine upload`, and include dist-tag promotion step gated on smoke success.
kevin: Also add a pinned-deps PR template for large consumers calling out: "During rollout pin to `>=1.6.3 <1.7` if you need stability" so we can avoid surprise breaks.
elaine: One more: update Console version mapping so hosted fallback can route legacy traffic to a dedicated variant if we see errors.
release-bot: Deploy job created: id=4321. To trigger: `@release-bot trigger 4321`. Auto-rollback currently disabled.
elaine: Let's enable auto-rollback if error rate >5% in first 30m. Sam, can you add alerting?
sam: Added alert rule `pyts-release-err-rate` threshold=5% window=5m, notify=#eng-oncall. Runbook linked in rule.
kevin: After promotion, run `npm deprecate redwood-js-sdk@\"<1.7.0\" \"Deprecated: legacy sync client. See https://redwood.dev/migrations/sync-to-async\"` so old pins get an install-time warning.
elaine: Perfect. Plan: ship canary at 22:00 PT. Everyone monitor #devex and #incidents for the first hour. I'll post a short release note when we promote. :thumbsup:
